definition: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity with respect to time.

worked_examples.problem_statement: Calculate the acceleration of an object whose velocity changes from 10 m/s to 20 m/s in 5 seconds.
solution_steps: Identify the initial and final velocities (10 m/s and 20 m/s).
Use the formula for average acceleration.

visual_metaphor: A car accelerating on a straight road.
